body:
#### PR description:

towards https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/46483

This is a defensive fix to avoid shift exponent too large for 32-bit type int. It may not be the best fix, since the issue may be on the value of `nMaxVFAT` as discussed in the aforementioned issue.

fyi @smuzaffar @cms-sw/gem-dpg-l2 

#### PR validation:

```bash
scram b && scram b code-checks && scram b code-format && scram b
```
title: [UBSAN][DQM] bound VFAT mask shift to the 24-bit OH mask width
